title: Emergence
hook: Nobody designed your culture. It showed up from how everyone works.
statement: Your system creates outcomes you never designed.
explainer: Culture and reputation come from interactions. Great parts can still add up mediocre.
sop: Change how parts connect, not the parts.
equation_example: Team-Customers 7 + Product-Marketing 8 + Culture-Process 6 = 21. That sum drives your culture.
question: Write down one result nobody planned. Find its cause.
closing_statement: The whole plays by different rules.
